actor: UK-based threat actor (tracked by Anthropic as GTG-5004)
impact: AI-assisted development, marketing and sale of ransomware variants with encryption and evasion capabilities on dark-web forums for US$400-1,200; no victim count stated by the source.
name: GTG-5004 AI-assisted ransomware-as-a-service operation

sources.title: Detecting and countering misuse of AI: August 2025

summary: In its August 2025 Threat Intelligence Report, Anthropic disclosed a UK-based threat actor it tracked as GTG-5004 that used Claude to develop, market and sell ransomware with evasion features through a ransomware-as-a-service model. Anthropic reports the actor — active since at least January 2025 on dark-web forums — appears dependent on the AI to produce functional malware, and sold ransomware packages priced from US$400 to US$1,200.
